name: Staff override of controls or excessive record access
description: Employees override approvals, alter records, access records without need or show unusual relationships with customers.
fp: Privileged roles and emergency fixes legitimately involve overrides; require documented approval.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services, 2016

FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)

ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)
Fraud Advisory Panel (UK), guidance on internal fraud (general)
COSO and ACFE, Fraud Risk Management Guide (2016)

links.name: Staff override of controls or excessive record access
links.ctx: Staff bypass or override screening, monitoring or approval steps, or access records of customers outside their duties, for a particular set of customers.

links.name: Staff collusion or insider risk indicators
links.ctx: Employees show unusual relationships with customers, override controls or access records without need.

links.name: Excessive access or override of controls
links.ctx: Privileged users bypass approvals or alter records.
